title: Biodegradation Property of 8:2 Fluorotelomer Alcohol (8:2 FTOH) under Aerobic/Anoxic/Anaerobic Conditions
environment_matrix: activated sludge mixed liquor from an industrial wastewater treatment plant
reason_not_in_main_database: Activated sludge is an engineered wastewater-treatment matrix and is not considered natural environmental transformation evidence.
potential_use: Useful as auxiliary evidence for precursor biotransformation mechanisms, but excluded from the natural-environment PFAS transformation database.
evidence_quote: Within 24 hours, the transformed PFCAs (C4-C9) moles to the applied 8:2 FTOH were 11.12%, 0.46% and 3.39% under aerobic/anoxic/anaerobic conditions, respectively. Under aerobic condition, PFCAs were remarkably generated. The increased moles of PFOA and PFHpA occupied the applied 8:2 FTOH as 7.87% and 1.29%, respectively.
